title: MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using visual prompt attacks (combining malicious text queries with query-relevant images generated via Stable Diffusion or typography) to measure the Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Refusal Rate (RR) of models when prompted to generate hateful, harassing, or violent content based on an individual's identity.

Evaluating the model's adherence to political neutrality by measuring its Attack Success Rate (ASR) when subjected to multimodal jailbreak prompts designed to make the model express political opinions, generate campaign materials, or engage in political lobbying.
